note: 26/11: Danh sach chinh TRONG (DDOG da loai 02/11, NVDA da loai 02/11, OKTA da loai 06/11, BIIB da loai 25/11 — kich hoat $241 tu 20/10, chay xa >10%; dong 25/11 $261,44, sau gio $261,70 — bang chung gom KHONG bi pha qua dem: khong ha hang lon, khong insider ban cum; Wall Street Zen chi ha Strong Buy->Buy; dong thuan van Moderate Buy; nhung setup 'chuan bi bung no' da hoan thanh, khong dua lai. BIIB van tren bang, vung mua $228-235, cat dong cua duoi $220, muc tieu $300 — chi vao khi chinh ve vung. Thi truong nghi Le Ta on, tin mong — khong co ma moi qua du 3 cua loc gat.
